case_number: 2025 INSC 68; MISC. APPLICATION NO. OF 2025 [@ DIARY NO. 38122 OF 2024] IN CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 110 OF 2019 IN CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017
summary: Absorption ordered post-J. Sinha Commission ruling; pension withheld following Baidya Nath Choudhary contempt proceedings; salary arrears and pension claims require fact-finding enquiry; direction to university authorities to adjudicate claims within three months; excess recovery permitted upon verification; appeal against university order allowed before High Court.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Miscellaneous application disposed of with directions for Registrar/Vice Chancellor to adjudicate salary arrears and pension claims within three months; excess recovery permitted upon verification; appeal against university order allowed before High Court.
